title: Why is an animation out of bounds
question: Why is an animation out of bounds?
answer: The character leaves its own slot or reaches into a neighbouring slot on the animation sheet. It is off by default, but a judgement-call boundary warning can be allowed with the visible override. If this does not match what you see, send a screenshot in Help.
looks_like: Animation shows out of bounds (off), and the tile can offer Include anyway.
